projects.title: Interpretable and Controllable Neural Shape Parameterizations
projects.summary: Aims to make neural representations of 2D and 3D shapes, such as DeepGeo-style networks with mesh-based deformation, easier to interpret and control, so that changing a shape parameter has predictable effects.

projects.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Flight Dynamics
projects.summary: Aims to learn how an aircraft responds to control inputs from observation alone, using self-supervised methods such as Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA), without physical models or manually labeled data.

projects.title: Structured 3D Shape Optimization with Part-Based Implicit Neural Representations
projects.summary: Uses part-based implicit neural representations, where an auto-decoder decodes latent vectors and poses into shape parts, to generate, edit and optimize structured, modular 3D shapes for engineering design.

projects.title: Recovering Thin Structures in 3D Foundation Models
projects.summary: Investigates how to improve transformer-based 3D foundation models, which predict scene geometry and camera parameters, so that they recover thin structures that are lost due to rough patchification.

projects.title: Applied Deep Learning for Computer Aided Engineering
projects.summary: Aims to use deep learning to automate Computer Aided Engineering (CAE) processes in order to reduce the time, human resource and R&D costs of industrial engineering and manufacturing.

projects.title: Real-Time 3D Tracking and Anomaly Detection for Maritime Kite Systems
projects.summary: Develops a 360-degree vision-based redundancy system for real-time 3D tracking of kites for Aether Swiss Kite's maritime kite wing system, building on a previous semester project, with anomaly detection for safety and reliability.

projects.title: Efficient Diffusion Models via Quantization and Compression
projects.summary: Aims to explore and systematically evaluate quantization and compression methods for diffusion models such as Stable Diffusion, to reduce their computational and memory cost for deployment on resource-constrained devices.

projects.title: 3D Surface reconstruction using 3D Gaussians and SDF
projects.summary: Aims to reconstruct 3D surfaces by combining 3D Gaussian Splatting with signed distance functions (SDF), building on methods such as SuGaR.

projects.title: Computer Vision for Waste Management (CVLab x Wasteflow)
projects.summary: A computer vision project for waste management, offered jointly by CVLAB and Wasteflow. The page gives no further description.

projects.title: Interpretable and Controllable Neural Shape Parameterizations
projects.summary: Research project to build on DeepGeo and develop methods that make neural 2D/3D shape parameterizations more interpretable, controllable, and efficient to optimize. Candidate directions include automatically constructing parameter directions tied to geometric properties (e.g. airfoil thickness, camber, wing twist) and building compact, adaptive parameter spaces for better optimization convergence.

projects.title: Open-Source Work on Dynamic High-level Synthesis Compiler Targeting FPGAs
projects.summary: Contribute to Dynamatic, an open-source dynamic high-level synthesis compiler built on MLIR that generates RTL for FPGAs from C/C++. Possible work includes compiler passes at different lowering levels, or debugging, visualisation and benchmarking tools; contributions are intended to become part of the codebase.

projects.title: Accelerate FPGA Implementation Time
projects.summary: The project aims to reduce the FPGA bitstream implementation time, currently several minutes, to a few seconds for designs produced by high-level synthesis from C/C++.

projects.title: Postquantum Cryptography Core Using High-Level Synthesis
projects.summary: The project explores and improves the quality of results of post-quantum cryptography hardware cores generated with high-level synthesis, compared with RTL-based designs.

projects.title: Low-Level Optimization of Dynamically Scheduled Circuits
projects.summary: The project investigates optimizations applied after the dynamic HLS compiler output, at the RTL-to-FPGA implementation stage, using Vivado logic synthesis and place-and-route to account for physical constraints such as routing delays and congestion.

projects.title: Toward Coarse-Grained Field Programmable Gate Arrays
projects.summary: The project studies a coarser-grained version of FPGAs as a word-level reconfigurable computing fabric for data centre applications, with opportunities in compiler optimisations, new architectural ideas, and physical implementation and modelling.

projects.title: Optimizing place and route for high frequency task parallel FPGA accelerators
projects.summary: The project analyses the clock frequency of circuits generated by the open-source HardCilk scheduler for task-parallel FPGA acceleration, and tests whether adding elastic buffers to its ready-valid interfaces improves frequency using Vivado place and route.

projects.title: SOC-graphical configurator as VS-code plug-in
projects.summary: The project aims to build a graphical SoC configurator, similar to Quartus QSYS, as a cross-platform VS Code plug-in for the OpenRisc-based embedded systems used in CS-473 and CS-476, with export of SoC designs as TikZ pictures and PDF.

projects.title: Hardware coherence on various wishbone bus-architectures
projects.summary: The project studies Wishbone bus architectures (shared, crossbar, ring) and aims to propose and implement software-configurable hardware cache coherence protocols on a system based on Hazard3 RISC-V CPUs.

projects.title: Quantum constraint satisfaction problems
projects.summary: Investigate quantum versions of constraint satisfaction problems such as K-SAT, where N quantum bits (spin-1/2) are subject to M constraints acting on them.

projects.title: Message passing for Quantum Models
projects.summary: Develop message passing techniques for simple quantum spin models on graphs.

projects.title: Universal prediction and alpha-mutual information
projects.summary: Experimentally study the performance of a newly devised class of predictors that estimate data sequences when information about the generating distribution is limited, based on a generalized definition of mutual information.

projects.title: Cryptocurrencies
projects.summary: Several master project openings as part of the lab's ongoing research on designing new cryptocurrency systems. Students should contact Prof. Rachid Guerraoui.

projects.title: Scalable Distributed Cache Coherency
projects.summary: Master project on reducing the communication overhead of distributed cache coherency protocols while keeping their performance, so that they scale across large systems. Interested students should contact Beatrice Shokry.

projects.title: Accelerating Safe ML Systems
projects.summary: Master project on building fast and secure distributed machine learning systems by using RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) for efficient, secure communication between machines during large-model training. Interested students should contact Beatrice Shokry.

projects.title: Distributed Resource Efficient Inference Engine
projects.summary: Master project on the distributed inference engine Anyd, which aggregates heterogeneous hardware over any network into a unified cluster for running generative AI inference and handling failures transparently. Interested students should contact Geovani Rizk.

projects.title: Improving Coverage Reliability in Cortex-M Firmware Rehosting
projects.summary: Studies how firmware rehosting approximations (MMIO, interrupts, timers, DMA) affect the reliability of coverage reported by coverage-guided fuzzing of Cortex-M firmware. The goal is to build a framework recording coverage with execution-context information and to develop techniques that improve fuzzing effectiveness on rehosted firmware.

projects.title: Ownership-Aware Bug Hunting in Rust Crates
projects.summary: Aims to build an ownership-aware bug detection mechanism for Rust crates that models ownership transitions induced by unsafe APIs, such as bitwise copies that lead to double-free bugs. The approach targets cases the Rust compiler cannot track or enforce.

projects.title: Dataset Acquisition for Low-Light Image Denoising
projects.summary: Capture a new dataset of clean/noisy image pairs and dark calibration frames at many different exposure times, to extend the 2-Shots in the Dark low-light denoising method to a wider range of exposure times and sensor temperatures. The student sorts and preprocesses the data and publishes it on Hugging Face with a dataset card.

projects.title: Does Personalization in Medical Collaborative Learning Learn Site Shortcuts?
projects.summary: Investigates whether standard personalized federated learning methods learn site-specific shortcuts (spurious correlations) when trained on medical imaging data across hospitals. The results are meant to inform a personalization method that keeps useful site-specific features while avoiding shortcuts.

projects.title: Whose bubble is it? Harvesting idle capacity in data-parallel, expert-parallel LLM serving
projects.summary: Characterizes where GPU idle capacity arises in data-parallel, expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts LLM serving and under what conditions it can be harvested for parameter-efficient fine-tuning without causing service-level objective violations across replicas.

projects.title: Noise or Lies? Distinguishing privacy protection from fairwashing in black-box audits
projects.summary: Studies when an external auditor, who only queries a platform's decisions, can tell an honest privacy-preserving platform apart from one that adversarially manipulates answers to fairwash a discriminatory model.

projects.title: Privacy Vulnerability Transfer in Model Merging
projects.summary: Studies how membership inference and extraction privacy vulnerabilities of constituent language models propagate into merged models built with task arithmetic, and how merging coefficients, number of merged models and task similarity affect this transfer.

projects.title: In-context learning as approximated Bayesian inference
projects.summary: The project challenges the generality of the "in-context learning as gradient descent" hypothesis for transformers. It aims to show that, for more complex statistical problems and architectures, transformers learn more sophisticated mechanisms than gradient descent.

projects.title: Controlling the timbre of wind instruments with active control
projects.summary: The project investigates active control of the timbre of wind instruments, which are modelled as axisymmetric hollow ducts with varying or constant cross-section.

projects.title: Plasmacoustic headphones
projects.summary: The project builds on the corona discharge principle, which can produce a linear acoustic flow velocity source without a conventional membrane, to develop plasma-based headphones.

projects.title: Development of a Graphical User Interface for Electroacoustic Absorbers
projects.summary: The project aims to develop a graphical user interface for the Electroacoustic Absorber, a closed-box loudspeaker whose membrane is assigned a prescribed acoustic impedance.

projects.title: Exploration and improvement of a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture relying on a novel fusion strategy
projects.summary: The project explores and improves a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture that processes several information channels (modalities) using a novel fusion strategy.

projects.title: Auditory distance perception
projects.summary: The project studies auditory distance perception, the ability to estimate how far away a sound source is, which supports spatial awareness and obstacle avoidance.

projects.title: 3D Sound Localization
projects.summary: The project addresses sound localization in space, the spatial hearing function that lets people perceive where sounds come from in three dimensions.

projects.title: Design of unprecedented sound sources: a dream come true with plasma loudspeakers?
projects.summary: The project explores the design of novel sound sources based on a spherical geometry, which is considered optimal because of limited scattering, using plasma loudspeakers.

projects.title: Optimization of corona discharge loudspeakers
projects.summary: The project aims to optimize corona discharge loudspeakers, which use the corona discharge principle to produce a linear acoustic flow velocity source without a conventional membrane.

projects.title: Modeling translation elongation dynamics through Variational AutoEncoders
projects.summary: The project uses Variational AutoEncoders to model translation elongation dynamics, building on ribosome profiling data that measures codon-specific ribosome dwell times.

projects.title: Enhancing Protein Design Through Advanced Graph Neural Networks
projects.summary: The project applies advanced graph neural networks to protein design, motivated by the growing use of machine learning in biology.

projects.title: Development and characterization of an acoustic matched source
projects.summary: The project develops and characterizes an acoustic matched source, drawing on nonlinear and time-varying systems used in wave engineering to go beyond conventional materials.

projects.title: VENOVA : an actively modified cylindrical cross-saxophone
projects.summary: The project concerns an actively modified cylindrical cross-saxophone, based on a design the page attributes to engineers from Yamaha after research, modelling and adjustments.

projects.title: Controlling the timbre of wind instruments with active control
projects.summary: The project aims to build a scaled prototype of an active wind instrument: a cylindrical hollow duct with a ring of active electroacoustic absorbers that alter its acoustic impedance and thus its timbre. The work includes COMSOL FEM simulations, prototype development, and acoustic assessment of the resonators and the whole instrument.

projects.title: Continuous-Domain Phase Retrieval in Dimension One
projects.summary: Project on continuous-domain phase retrieval in one dimension, as listed by the Biomedical Imaging Group. The page gives only the title and level.

projects.title: Training Complex-Valued Denoisers for Phase Retrieval
projects.summary: Project on training complex-valued denoisers for phase retrieval. The page gives only the title and level.

projects.title: Exploring Global Youth Art Through AI: A Semantic Analysis of the IMAJ Collection
projects.summary: Semantic analysis of the IMAJ art collection using AI methods, to explore global youth art. The page gives only the title and level.

projects.title: High-Dimensional Gaussian Sampling: Cholesky versus Markov
projects.summary: Project comparing Cholesky-based and Markov-based approaches to Gaussian sampling in high dimensions. The page gives only the title and levels.

projects.title: Sampling from Learned Regularizers
projects.summary: Project on sampling from learned regularizers for inverse problems. The page gives only the title and level.

projects.title: Analysis of dendritic spine changes using deep-learning encoding in a latent space
projects.summary: Analysis of changes in dendritic spines using deep-learning encoding in a latent space. The page marks this project as reserved.

projects.title: Automated image analysis of tau fibrils in the human Alzheimer's disease brain
projects.summary: Automated image analysis of tau fibrils in human Alzheimer's disease brain tissue. The page marks this project as reserved.

projects.title: Data curation and curriculum learning for pre-training, theory and practice
projects.summary: Semester project on data curation and curriculum learning for LLM pre-training, combining theory and practice. Part of the group of projects around large language models / Apertus.

projects.title: Scaling to longer context windows through modifications of attention
projects.summary: Semester project on scaling LLMs to longer context windows by modifying the attention mechanism. Part of the projects around large language models / Apertus.

projects.title: Efficiency engineering for LLM pretraining and specifically MoE architectures
projects.summary: Semester project on engineering efficiency for LLM pre-training, with a focus on mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures. Part of the projects around large language models / Apertus.

projects.title: Tools-usage during pretraining & finetuning
projects.summary: Semester project on integrating tool usage into LLM pre-training and finetuning. Part of the projects around large language models / Apertus.

projects.title: Safety and alignment during pretraining
projects.summary: Semester project on safety and alignment of LLMs during the pre-training stage. Part of the projects around large language models / Apertus.

projects.title: Novel architectures (including efficient long context or MoE related mechanisms)
projects.summary: Semester project on novel neural architectures, including efficient long-context and mixture-of-experts mechanisms. Part of the projects around large language models / Apertus.

projects.title: Optimization dynamics for LLMs (e.g. Muon and AdEMAmix variants, and interactions with architecture)
projects.summary: Semester project on optimization dynamics for LLMs, studying optimizers such as Muon and AdEMAmix variants and their interaction with architecture. Part of the projects around large language models / Apertus.

projects.title: LLM inference on old V100 GPUs
projects.summary: Make recent large open-weight MoE models run efficiently on the EPFL cluster of V100 GPUs and compare with newer GPU generations, applying quantization and communication-efficient parallelism with inference frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

projects.title: Communication-efficient gossip methods for replacing all-reduce in distributed LLM training
projects.summary: Implement decentralized pairwise averaging of weights instead of all-to-all communication in distributed LLM training, and study how model and data parallelism settings and communication compression affect it.

projects.title: AI safety evaluations feeding back into Apertus Posttraining
projects.summary: Work with UN agencies such as UNICC to incorporate findings from recent red-teaming studies into the posttraining recipes (safety SFT and RL) of the next generation Apertus model.

projects.title: LLM Pretraining Data Curation
projects.summary: Advance pre-training data curation beyond baselines such as FineWeb-2 HQ through novel signal extraction, semantic filtering and partially synthetic augmentation or rephrasing, in English or multilingual settings. One idea is to study the impact of data quality on the curse of multilinguality and scaling laws.

projects.title: Learning to sample on the fly for SGD / curriculum learning
projects.summary: Use an auxiliary network that learns to score training data points so that an improved subset of points is selected during SGD training, exploring several ways to train the auxiliary parameters.

projects.title: Improving factuality understanding for LLM training
projects.summary: Add a per-document factuality tag or masking to guide LLM training toward distinguishing factual from non-factual content, with the goal of reducing hallucinations; post-training techniques may also be investigated.

projects.title: Build decentralized LLMs in the browser
projects.summary: Practical project joining a larger team building decentralized and federated training software (DISCO) in which many clients, such as phones or hospitals, collaboratively train ML models such as smaller LLMs while preserving data privacy. Students familiar with Rust, or motivated to learn it, are sought to integrate Burn within DISCO.

projects.title: Contrastive latent alignment for multimodal reasoning
projects.summary: Explore a contrastive latent alignment process that enforces cross-modal and preference alignment within continuous latent reasoning paths, to correct corrupted representations caused by conflicting sensory signals. Possible methods include cross-modal contrastive trajectory optimization combined with direct preference alignment over continuous latent manifolds.

projects.title: Locating and ablating circuit-level private attribute sub-networks
projects.summary: Use activation-space dictionary learning to locate the circuits in AI models that encode private attributes (PII), then ablate or orthogonalize those latent directions to remove PII while preserving zero-shot task performance, without retraining or fine-tuning the model.

projects.title: Continuous latent flow matching for multimodal spatial reasoning
projects.summary: Develop a single-step continuous latent flow architecture that maps multimodal inputs (video, audio, language instructions) directly to latent action-reasoning representations for Vision-Language-Action models, aiming for accurate spatial problem-solving in a single forward pass.

projects.title: Alignment-based conformance checking
projects.summary: Develop a neuro-symbolic conformance checking framework that translates natural-language regulatory articles (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR) into linear temporal logic specifications and evaluates them on execution traces of multi-agent systems, to detect and explain compliance failures.

projects.title: Visual stream parsing for compliance auditing
projects.summary: Design a real-time legal-visual concept engine that extends static concept probing to video streams by combining vision-language streaming transformers with ontology graph mapping, to track entities, infer sensitive personal attributes, and map scene semantics to legal frameworks such as the EU AI Act and GDPR.

projects.title: Voice anonymization with preservation of emotional prosody in multilingual settings
projects.summary: Design, implement and evaluate an AI-based acoustic transformation framework that masks speaker identity while preserving emotional prosody, semantic meaning and intelligibility, focusing on French/Italian, German and Swiss German. Evaluation with human participants and real-world datasets is done with Radio Télévision Suisse (RTS).

projects.title: Linguistic and stylometric style transfer for long-form speech anonymization
projects.summary: Use sequence-to-sequence style-transfer models to obfuscate speaker-specific linguistic markers (accent, dialect, syntax, vocabulary, phrasing) in long-form recordings, going beyond redaction of explicit PII. Focus on French/Italian, German and Swiss German, with evaluation with RTS.

projects.title: Privacy guarantees for speech anonymization
projects.summary: Build a framework that explicitly bounds and minimizes mutual information across acoustic, emotional and linguistic modalities of speech, providing information-theoretic privacy guarantees against adaptive adversaries. Evaluation with human participants and real-world datasets is done with RTS.

projects.title: Project 1: Comparing Representational Hierarchies in Neural Networks
projects.summary: Investigates how layer selection and aggregation affect conclusions about representational similarity between neural networks. The student will develop a principled approach to compare pretrained models across their full representational hierarchies and reassess evidence for representational convergence.

projects.title: Project 2: What Do Language Models Need from 3D Encoders?
projects.summary: Studies what 3D representations (point clouds or Gaussian splats) must contain and how they should be learned so that a language model can use them for 3D scene reasoning. The student will analyze what different pretrained 3D encoders contribute in a controlled 3D LLM pipeline and explore ways to make them more useful, extending to modeling spatial organization of cells.

projects.title: Project 3: Learning patient-level predictions from the spatial proteome
projects.summary: Develops a multiple instance learning approach for patient-level prediction from spatial single-cell and multiplexed imaging data, aggregating information across spatial scales from single cells to niches and whole-tissue organization. The method will be tested on public cohorts with patient outcomes such as cancer survival.

projects.title: Project 4: Improving agents for single-cell genomics and biomedical discovery
projects.summary: Aims to improve LLM-based agents for single-cell biology tasks such as hypothesis generation, validation design and computational workflows by training them with agentic reinforcement learning. The page targets long-horizon, non-verifiable domains.

projects.title: Master's semester projects on self-supervised learning for behavioral and neural analysis
projects.summary: Semester projects and theses on self-supervised learning for analysing behavioral and neural data, building on tools such as CEBRA and DeepLabCut. Students are asked to contact the postdocs and PhD students whose work interests them.

projects.title: Master's semester projects on biomechanics
projects.summary: Semester projects and theses on biomechanics within the M-Lab, building on tools such as DeepLabCut. Students are asked to contact the postdocs and PhD students whose work interests them.

projects.title: Use computational tools to study neural circuit activity
projects.summary: Use computer vision and machine learning to extract neural activity patterns during behavior and predict relationships between behavioral and internal states. The project sits at the interface of computer science and neurobiology.

projects.title: Build artificial neural networks to control a simulated fly.
projects.summary: Develop biorealistic controllers for a physics-based neuromechanical simulation of the Drosophila melanogaster fly. The project lies at the interface of robotics, computer science and neuroscience.

projects.title: Use robotic systems to automate biological experimentation
projects.summary: Develop automated vision-guided robotic systems that perform behavioral and/or neural studies, to automate and democratize biological experimentation. The project sits at the interface of robotics and neurobiology.

projects.title: Use computational tools to study animal behavior
projects.summary: Use computational and machine learning approaches to quantify and segment fly behavior into individual actions, and link these sequences to simultaneously acquired neuroimaging data.

projects.title: Study the full graph (connectome) of the fly nervous system
projects.summary: Improve and explore the fly connectome graph to answer specific questions about neural circuit motifs underlying complex motor behaviors. The project sits at the interface of computer science, mathematics and biology.

projects.title: Behavioral studies in the laboratory
projects.summary: Hands-on experimental work with flies to examine how neural activation or other perturbations modulate animal behavior, including designing experiments and analyzing the student's own data.

projects.title: Build a robotic fly
projects.summary: Construct an insect-inspired robot and test bioinspired algorithms of limb control. The project is at the interface of robotics and biology, in collaboration with EPFL robotics groups.

projects.title: Reusable Foundations for Probabilistic Proofs in Lean
projects.summary: The project aims to build reusable Lean foundations for probability, similar to the LeanInfoTheory library on information theory, so that probabilists can more easily formalize their results. The scope will be decided first, then the framework written in Lean, and if time allows the library will be used to formalize a paper on random graphs and branching processes.

projects.title: Tracking Novel Research Through the Publication Process: A Text-Embedding Approach
projects.summary: Study scientific conservatism in peer review by measuring the novelty of submitted manuscripts with text embedding models. The student will review embedding models for semantic similarity and build a framework that matches rejected papers to their eventual publications, using anonymized manuscript and peer review data from the ICSR Lab.

projects.title: Measuring Entrepreneurial and Industry Identity in the Asteroid-Mining Industry with NLP
projects.summary: Study how entrepreneurs and institutions describe themselves as the asteroid-mining industry takes shape. The student will collect longitudinal text data by web scraping and build a machine learning pipeline that separates general topics from individual and collective identity claims, validated against a manually annotated sample.

projects.title: Accelerating Geophysical Flow Simulation Using Machine Learning
projects.summary: Develop and train a fast machine learning-based emulator of geophysical flows (e.g. at Blatten), using data from material point simulations and remote sensing. The goal is to avoid costly physics-based simulations of landslides, rockfalls and snow avalanches.

projects.title: Digital Twin Simulation of Rockfall Hazards
projects.summary: Build a Discrete Element Method computational framework that predicts rockfall runout, accounting for boulder shape derived from drone imagery and for boulder fragmentation.

projects.title: Discovering Internal Material Properties from Surface Observations
projects.summary: Use physics-informed neural operators to infer internal material properties from data available on the boundary, for applications such as subsurface engineering and material testing.

projects.title: Segregation in granular flows
projects.summary: Study segregation mechanisms in granular flows and how particle shape affects them, using the Discrete Element Method.

projects.title: Multiphysics Modeling of Fault Gouge
projects.summary: Study the contact mechanics and thermal and fluid multiphysics of fault gouge from both discrete and continuum modeling perspectives, to understand earthquake processes.

projects.title: Experimental Investigation of Architected Granular Materials
projects.summary: Explore architected granular materials (granular crystals and quasicrystals) for penetration applications through experiments.

projects.title: Phase-field Modeling of Fracture of Architected Structural Materials
projects.summary: Develop a micromechanics-informed phase-field computational model, potentially combined with deep learning, to capture fracture in architected materials and compare it against ongoing experiments.
